info.name: Boiaro — Subscription API
info.description:
# Boiaro Subscription API

All endpoints for managing subscription plans, initiating payments, and checking user subscription state in the Boiaro mobile app.

## Base URL
```
https://boiaro.com/api/v1
```

## Authentication
Protected endpoints require a Bearer token:
```
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
```
Set the `token` collection variable after signing in.

## Collection Variables

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | API base URL — `https://boiaro.com/api/v1` |
| `token` | Bearer access token from login |
| `plan_id` | Set after calling GET Plans |
| `subscription_id` | Set after calling POST Subscribe |

## Payment Gateway
Subscription payments use **SSLCommerz** only. After calling `POST /subscribe` for a paid plan, open the `gateway_url` in a WebView and intercept the redirect:

| Outcome | Redirect URL |
|---|---|
| Success | `https://boiaro.com/payment/callback?status=success&subscription_id=...` |
| Failure | `https://boiaro.com/payment/callback?status=failed` |
| Cancelled | `https://boiaro.com/payment/callback?status=cancelled` |

variable.description: Bearer access token — set after login
Subscription plan ID — set from GET /plans response

request.description:
Returns all active subscription plans sorted by display order.

**Auth:** Not required — public endpoint.

**Use this to:** Populate the plan selection screen in the app.

**Auto-save:** The test script automatically saves `plans[0].id` to the `plan_id` collection variable.

## Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Plan ID to pass to POST /subscribe |
| `name` | string | Display name |
| `description` | string | Short description |
| `price` | number | Price in BDT (0 = free) |
| `duration_days` | integer | Subscription length in days |
| `features` | object | Key-value feature flags |
| `is_featured` | boolean | Highlight this plan in the UI |
| `sort_order` | integer | Display order (ascending) |

response.name: 200 OK

exec: console.log('Subscribed to:', res.plan_name, '— days remaining:', res.days_remaining);

request.description:
Lightweight check of the user's current subscription state.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token.

**Use this to:** UI gates, banner visibility, upgrade prompts. Faster than fetching the full subscription object — call this on app launch or screen focus.

## Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `is_subscribed` | boolean | `true` if user has a valid active or cancelled-but-not-expired subscription |
| `status` | string\|null | `"active"`, `"cancelled"`, or `null` |
| `plan_name` | string\|null | Name of the current plan |
| `plan_features` | object\|null | Feature flags object from the plan |
| `end_date` | ISO string\|null | When access expires |
| `days_remaining` | integer\|null | Days left (0 = expires today) |

> **Note:** A cancelled subscription still returns `is_subscribed: true` until `end_date` passes. The user retains full access during this period.

response.name: 200 — Not Subscribed
response.body:
{
  "is_subscribed": false,
  "status": null,
  "plan_name": null,
  "plan_features": null,
  "end_date": null,
  "days_remaining": null
}

request.description:
Returns the full current subscription object including plan details.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token.

**Use this to:** Subscription detail / account screen. Returns `null` inside the `subscription` field when there is no active subscription.

**Auto-save:** The test script saves `subscription.id` to the `subscription_id` collection variable.

## Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `subscription.id` | string | Subscription ID |
| `subscription.plan_id` | string | Reference to the plan |
| `subscription.status` | string | `"active"` or `"cancelled"` |
| `subscription.start_date` | ISO string | When subscription started |
| `subscription.end_date` | ISO string | When access expires |
| `subscription.amount_paid` | number | Amount paid in BDT |
| `subscription.coupon_code` | string\|null | Coupon used, if any |
| `subscription.discount_amount` | number\|null | Discount applied in BDT |
| `subscription.plan` | object | Nested plan detail |

response.name: 200 — Active Subscription

exec: console.log('Total subscriptions:', res.total, '| Has more:', res.has_more);

request.description:
Paginated history of all the user's subscriptions — current and past.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token.

**Use this to:** Billing History screen.

## Query Parameters

| Param | Type | Default | Max | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | 10 | 50 | Records per page |
| `offset` | integer | 0 | — | Records to skip |

## Pagination Pattern
```
Page 1: limit=10&offset=0
Page 2: limit=10&offset=10
Page 3: limit=10&offset=20
```
Load the next page when `has_more` is `true`.

response.name: 200 OK

exec: console.log('Free plan — activated immediately. ID:', res.subscription.id);

request.description:
Initiates a subscription for the authenticated user.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token.

**Auto-save:** Test script saves `subscription_id` from the response automatically.

## Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plan_id` | string | ✅ Yes | Plan ID from `GET /plans` |
| `coupon_code` | string | No | Discount coupon code |
| `payment_method` | string | No | Only `"sslcommerz"` supported. Default: `"sslcommerz"` |

## Response — Paid Plan (requires WebView)

```json
{
  "requires_payment": true,
  "gateway_url": "https://securepay.sslcommerz.com/...",
  "subscription_id": "sub_xyz789",
  "transaction_id": "SUB-1720512345-ABCDE"
}
```

Open `gateway_url` in a WebView. Intercept navigation to detect outcome:

| Outcome | URL contains |
|---|---|
| ✅ Success | `status=success&subscription_id=...` |
| ❌ Failed | `status=failed` |
| ⏮ Cancelled | `status=cancelled` |

## Response — Free Plan (activated immediately)

```json
{
  "requires_payment": false,
  "subscription": {
    "id": "sub_xyz789",
    "status": "active",
    "end_date": "2026-08-09T00:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

## Error Responses

**409 — Already subscribed:**
```json
{
  "error": "You already have an active subscription...",
  "subscription_id": "sub_xyz789",
  "end_date": "2026-08-09T00:00:00.000Z"
}
```
**409 — Cancelled but still valid:**
```json
{
  "error": "You have a cancelled subscription that is still valid. You can re-subscribe after it expires.",
  "subscription_id": "sub_xyz789",
  "end_date": "2026-08-09T00:00:00.000Z"
}
```

response.name: 409 — Already Subscribed

exec: console.log('Coupon made it free — activated immediately');

request.description:
Same as Subscribe — Paid Plan but includes a coupon code.

If the coupon brings the price to **0** the subscription is activated immediately (`requires_payment: false`) with no WebView needed.

If the coupon provides a partial discount the response still has `requires_payment: true` and shows the discounted amount in the SSLCommerz gateway.

Cancels the user's current active subscription.

**Auth:** Required — Bearer token.

**No request body needed.**

## Behaviour

- Status is set to `"cancelled"` **immediately**
- User **retains full access** until `end_date`
- `GET /status` will still return `is_subscribed: true` until expiry
- User **cannot re-subscribe** until the current subscription expires

## Error Responses

**404 — No active subscription:**
```json
{ "error": "No active subscription to cancel" }
```
